summary: Listed as a forest lookout in Levy County, Florida, in an eastern U.S. directory; no other source found on its build, staffing or fate.

evidence.supports: Directory page is titled Usher under Forest Lookouts
Directory lists Usher in Levy County
Directory's Florida index lists Usher between Tucker Hill and Valrico; the Usher entry itself names no state

notes_for_editor: Only source is the directory page. Its Florida index lists Usher, and the Usher entry itself gives only Levy County. Two WebSearch queries and a cache search found no Usher tower in Levy County. Story is 38 words, well below the 120-word floor; recommend holding or dropping it unless a source turns up. Coordinates in the record (29.40766, -82.81921) come from the directory and were not verified.
